notes.id: Sekolah inklusi. Sumber menyebut dana Rp9.000.000 sudah termasuk seragam, SPP, tes MIR, kegiatan operasional, dan buku selama setahun.
notes.en: Inclusive school. The source says Rp9,000,000 covers uniforms, tuition, MIR test, operations and books for a year.
